_doc: gameimages: the pictures of a game found by their Ren'Py image name (loose files, a .rpa archive, aliases and chains of `image` statements, composite and layered images), the characters of the scripts, and the picture behind a script line (the last scene, the shows over it, hides, flat colours, layered scenes).

files.root/game/script.rpy:
define mc = Character("Main [name]", color="#ff0000")
define js = DynamicCharacter("jname", who_color='#0f0')
define narrator = Character(None)
define bad = Character
define mc = Character("Second")

image ep1_alias = "images/bg_cafe.jpg"
image maya happy = "Maya_Smile"
image maya anim:
    "ep1_cafe_maya1"
    pause 0.5
    "ep1_cafe_maya2"
    repeat
image comp = Composite((100,100), (0,0), "bg_cafe")
image comp_blink:
    "comp"
    pause 1
layeredimage eileen:
    always "eileen_base"
image hero = "hero_blink"
image chain1 = "chain2"
image chain2 = "chain3"
image chain3 = "bg_cafe"
image deep = "sub/Deep.PNG"

label start:
    scene black
    scene bg_cafe with fade
    show maya happy at left
    show hero at right as hero2
    mc "Hello"
    show maya anim
    show eileen happy
    hide hero2
    show nonexistent
    mc "Middle"
    scene ep1_alias
    show maya happy at center:
    scene eileen
    scene missing_one
    show chain1
    scene white
    show comp
    show deep at truecenter
    hide chain1
    mc "End"
files.root/game/other.rpy:
label other:
    show hero at left
    show maya happy at right
    mc "Only shows"
    scene ep1_cafe_maya1 with dissolve
    scene comp_blink
    mc "After"
